MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 14, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  tamalyn.sayre@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54996  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, April 9, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55049  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Department of
  Economic Development on the Long Beach Amphitheater and an update on Long
  Beach Lifeguard Station advertising.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55030  Recommendation to support the Parks, Recreation and Marine Director, or
  management designee, to execute the Personal Services and Instruction
  Agreements with the Long Beach Rowing Association and amend Attachment "A"
  of the agreements as needed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve Recommendation.

4.  26-55055  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Marine Bureau on
  vessel impound process, and abatement of impounded and abandoned vessels.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54997  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55001  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive, Marine & Beach Maintenance /

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 14, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

  Marina Operations, and Ad Hoc “Point of Historical Interest” Committees status
  report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon
the day prior to the meeting.
